record.name: ClawControl: AI Agent Hub
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Take full control of your AI agents from anywhere. ClawControl is an independent, open-source client app for self-hosted AI agent servers, published by Oaken Cloud Technologies, LLC.

Connect ClawControl to a compatible self-hosted AI agent server you operate, and chat in real-time with multiple AI models, manage agents, install community skills, and configure your private backend — all from one app.

Built for developers, power users, and privacy-conscious professionals who self-host their AI infrastructure.

REAL-TIME AI CHAT
Watch responses stream live with per-session isolation. Multiple agents can stream simultaneously without interference. Full Markdown rendering, syntax-highlighted code blocks with one-tap copy, and collapsible thinking blocks let you follow complex AI reasoning. Built on the new OpenClaw protocol v4 for faster, more reliable streaming.

MULTI-AGENT MANAGEMENT
Switch between AI agents without losing conversation context. Create custom agents with names, emojis, avatars, and dedicated workspaces. Override LLM models on a per-agent basis. Monitor agent status in real-time.

SUBAGENT VISIBILITY
See when your AI agent spawns parallel sub-tasks. Inline status blocks show subagent progress, and you can pop out any subagent session for side-by-side work.

SESSION ORGANIZATION
Sessions are grouped by date and searchable by title or message content. Unread badges keep you aware of background AI agent activity. Rename, delete, and navigate sessions from the collapsible sidebar.

CLAWHUB SKILL MARKETPLACE
Browse community-built skills with download counts, star ratings, and VirusTotal security scan badges. Install, enable, and manage skills on your server directly — no terminal required.

CRON JOB DASHBOARD
View scheduled AI automation tasks, check next-run times, and pause or resume jobs on the go. Full detail views give you complete schedule and execution history.

FULL SERVER CONFIGURATION
Configure your self-hosted server without leaving the app. Three organized tabs cover Agent Defaults (model, thinking level, context limits), Tools & Memory (web search, code execution, memory backend), and Channels (WhatsApp, Telegram, Discord, Slack, Signal, iMessage).

SECURE BY DESIGN
Tokens stored in iOS Keychain. Self-signed certificates supported through Trust-on-First-Use. Connect via password or token auth to servers on local networks, VPNs, or Tailscale.

BUILT FOR POWER USERS
Dark and light themes. Responsive layout from iPhone to iPad. Keyboard shortcuts for efficient workflows. Auto-reconnect with exponential backoff.

ClawControl is open source (MIT) and works with any compatible self-hosted AI agent server. Your data stays on your infrastructure.

Knoon is your AI team for everyday work. Delegate customer support, sales chat, accounting, social media, blogging, website updates, and more from one mobile workspace.

MEET YOUR AI EMPLOYEES
Nova — Personal assistant
Pip — Customer support
Sage — Website creator

Mia — SEO and blog writer
Fin — Accountant

Soshie — Social media manager

Connect your tools so your chat agents can do more than answer questions.
• Add leads to Excel, Google Sheets, HubSpot, or Salesforce
• Open invoices in QuickBooks or Xero
• Arrange appointments through Google Calendar, Outlook Calendar, or Microsoft Bookings

record.name: Palvia: AI Agents in Your Palm
record.offering: Utilities app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Put an AI Agent in your pocket and unleash true intelligence anywhere.

Most AI chat apps on the market are just simple conversation boxes. Palvia is completely different. It is a full-featured, native AI Agent platform running directly on your iPhone. In Palvia, every Agent has its own "soul", memory, and custom skills. They don't just chat with you; they can execute code, navigate websites, and run automated background tasks.

Palvia turns your iPhone into a portable AI command center with zero server setup required.

Core Features:

- Multi-Agent Architecture
Say goodbye to generic bots. You can create multiple unique AI Agents and define their behaviors using flexible Markdown configurations for their SOUL (personality), MEMORY, and USER (your profile). Agents can even generate and manage sub-agents to collaborate on complex workflows.

- On-Device Code Execution
Turn your device into a mobile code library. Palvia features a secure, sandboxed JavaScript interpreter. Your Agents can write, execute, and evaluate code locally to solve problems. You can also save and manage useful code snippets for future use.

- AI-Driven Web Automation
Equipped with a built-in browser, Palvia allows Agents to navigate web pages, click elements, fill out forms, and extract data autonomously via Function Calling. You always maintain control: a live status banner shows when the AI is browsing, and you can manually take over at any time.

- Multi-LLM Provider Support (BYOK)
Bring your own API key. Palvia is fully compatible with any OpenAI-format API endpoint. Seamlessly switch between OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, or even locally deployed models like Ollama. Enjoy real-time typewriter effects with full SSE streaming support.

- Smart Context & Infinite Memory
Never worry about your AI losing track of long conversations. Palvia features an automatic context compression engine. When a conversation exceeds token limits, it automatically extracts summaries and injects them into the system prompt, giving your Agents continuous long-term memory.

- Powerful Tools & Scheduled Cron Jobs
Empower your Agents with an installable Skill system and robust Function Calling capabilities. You can even schedule system-level Cron Jobs, allowing your AI to wake up in the background and handle routine tasks automatically.

- Seamless Apple HealthKit Integration
Transform your AI into a personalized health and wellness companion. Palvia integrates directly with Apple HealthKit, enabling your Agents to securely read, analyze, and record your health metrics. You can simply chat with your Agent to log your daily water intake, record a workout, or ask it to analyze your step counts and sleep trends to generate customized health insights—all powered by your chosen LLM. (Note: Health data is only processed during active conversations and is routed exclusively to the API endpoint you personally configure, never to our servers.)

- Absolute Data Privacy
Your data never touches our servers. All chat logs, Agent configurations, and memories are saved 100% locally on your device using Apple's SwiftData framework. Your AI and your data belong entirely to you.

Palvia is the ultimate tool for AI enthusiasts, developers, and productivity seekers. Download now and start building your personal AI Agent empire!

In-built Browser Agent: Consciouss contains an extremely lightweight browser agent which actually resides inside the application and works locally on the device. Consciouss controls the in-app browser to perform many agentic tasks.

Digital Services Copilot: Your own on-phone copilot for online shopping, food delivery, ride orders, restaurant reservations, event tickets, and more using the in-built browser agent.

Anyone who wishes they could do more with their phones.

record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Let Whistant do the Tedious

Let Whistant do the tedious — your on-phone AI buddy that helps you get things done. Whistant doesn't just give ideas; it takes real actions, right from your iPhone.

From Idea to Real Action
Most AI tools stop at brainstorming or a single step. Whistant breaks your request into step-by-step subtasks and executes them: run Shortcuts, operate files, send messages or emails, place calls, browse the web, or call third-party APIs — all assembled like LEGO bricks and driven by a single prompt.

Your Trusted On-Phone Colleague
Whistant runs tools on your device and reasons about what to do next before acting. It thinks through multi-step actions for accuracy and reliability — then performs them with transparent, local execution. You stay in control: start, pause, or edit a running task and see exactly what's being executed in real time.

Skills — Ready-Made Superpowers, Instantly Available
Skills are self-contained capability packs that give Whistant new powers: connect Gmail, Google Calendar, Drive, Outlook, OneDrive, LinkedIn, and more with secure OAuth sign-in — no passwords stored. Install community skills from an ever-growing library of 600+ vetted recipes, or build and share your own. Each skill brings its own scripts, guides, and examples so the agent knows exactly how to act.

JavaScript Terminal — Run Code, Your Way
Whistant includes a full JavaScript runtime on your device. The agent can write and execute JS scripts to fetch APIs, transform data, automate logic, and chain operations — with access to Node-compatible modules and the ability to install packages on demand. Think of it as a programmable layer between your words and the world.

Orchestrate iPhone Shortcuts — Build modular pieces for agent to use Apps
Compose complex workflows by combining Shortcuts as modular pieces. Want to collect a file, summarize it, pick the best time on your calendar, and ping a contact with the result? Whistant stitches Shortcuts together safely and clearly so you don't have to script every detail. You can also build your own Shortcuts for Whistant to execute.

Browse, Book, and Fill — From the Browser on Your Phone
Whistant automates real browser interactions on your device — searching, filling booking forms, comparing options, and following checkout flows — while keeping the automation local. It can open links, capture page content, handle OAuth sign-in flows, and hand actions back to you for approval when needed.

Your Model, Your Choice
Connect Whistant to the AI backend that fits your needs. Use the built-in cloud service, point it at your own Ollama server, or register a custom backend. Choose different models for different job types — reasoning, execution, summarization — and switch vendors without losing your workflows.

Privacy-First: Minimal Cloud Relay, Local-First Execution
Most actions run on your device. When cloud LLM or API calls are needed, Whistant uses minimal, explicit relay for only those requests and only for features you enable. Permissions and prompts are clear — you always control which services Whistant may use.

Save Time, Keep Control
Work that used to take hours — gathering data, combining calendar + files + messages, or cross-app workflows — can be automated while you keep the final say. Whistant handles the details; you keep the control.

Privacy Policy: https://whisolla.com/terms.html#privacy
